category.description: Allowlist category the company matched in config/companies_allowlist.yml (e.g. 'faang', 'big_tech', 'cloud_infra'), or '' if the row was only included via a relaxed-mode fallback without a strict allowlist hit

region.description: Coarse region detected from location, same taxonomy as the public layer's region field ('mena' = Middle East & Africa, matched before 'emea')

role_type.description: Engineering discipline detected from title, same taxonomy as the public layer's role_type

country.description: Detected country name, or 'Remote'/'Unknown' when not recognized

age.description: Human-readable time since posting (e.g. '0d', '5d', 'Recently'), or '' when unknown. Free-form: sourced verbatim from the origin site when available, otherwise computed from posted_at.

tech_tags.description: Canonical tech/skill tags explicitly named in the posting text (scripts/patterns.py detect_tech_tags). Present only for sources that carry a job description (Remotive, ArbeitNow); community-tracker rows have no description and so no key. Never guessed

visa_sponsorship.description: Present only when the posting text is explicit: true if it offers visa sponsorship, false if it states none is available. Absent when unstated

degree_required.description: Present only when the posting text is explicit: true if a degree is required, false if it explicitly says none is needed. Absent when unstated

relocation.description: Present only when the posting text explicitly offers relocation assistance (true) or explicitly rules it out (false). Absent when unstated

salary.description: A literal pay range lifted verbatim from the posting (scripts/patterns.py parse_salary). Absent unless the posting itself discloses a currency-marked two-ended range that passes sanity checks — never estimated

closed_at.description: UTC timestamp this row was archived. Only present in data/jobs-global-archive.json, never in data/jobs-global.json
